package.description: Sound analysis software for bioacoustic research.

en-US.description: Sound analysis software for bioacoustic research.
en-US.longDescription: Raven Pro is a software program for the acquisition, visualization, measurement, and analysis of sounds. Raven Pro provides a powerful, user-friendly research and teaching tool for scientists working with acoustic signals. Raven Pro’s highly configurable views provide unparalleled flexibility in data display.
en-US.name: Raven Pro
en-US.publisher: Bioacoustics Research Program - Cornell Lab of Ornithology

zh-CN.description: 用于生物声学研究的声音分析软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: Raven Pro 是一款用于声音获取、可视化、测量和分析的软件程序。Raven Pro 为处理声学信号的科学家提供了功能强大且用户友好的研究与教学工具。Raven Pro 高度可配置的视图在数据展示方面提供了无与伦比的灵活性。
